headline: Cognizant (CTSH) Stock Looks Reasonable On Earnings Despite Weak Returns
summary: Cognizant Technology Solutions stock has fallen about 47.1% year to date, yet its valuation checks still lean cheap, which sets up a clear tension between weak recent returns and what the numbers suggest about value. The share price is down 47.1% since the start of the year, which means current buyers are stepping in after a substantial reset in market expectations.
